Telemetry snapshot DEV-801 (last 2 hours):
- scanner_misread_rate: 23.1% (baseline: 0.4%, threshold: 2%)
- scan_retries_per_pick: 3.4 (baseline: 0.2)
- battery_level: 81%
- uptime_since_restart: 5h 40m
ANOMALY: scanner_misread_rate began climbing at 08:10 UTC, coinciding with v5.4.0 deployment reaching this device.

Fleet telemetry summary FLT-401 (last 2 hours):
- Fleet scanner_misread_rate: 12.7% (3/5 devices affected)
- Affected devices: DEV-801 (23.1%), DEV-802 (9.8%), DEV-803 (5.2%)
- Healthy devices: DEV-804, DEV-805 (all <0.5%, still on v5.3.2)
- Pattern: Only devices updated to v5.4.0 showing misreads
- Deployment DEPL-701 started at 07:00 UTC, reached devices at 08:05 UTC
CORRELATION: Misread onset directly correlates with v5.4.0 activation per device.

Runbook: Scanner Misread Troubleshooting
1. Check scanner firmware version against fleet baseline
2. Review misread rate by lighting zone
3. If error rate > 5% after an update, check exposure parameters
4. If post-update, consider rollback to previous version
5. Escalate to vision team if rollback doesn't resolve

Deployment manifest DEPL-701:
- Target: Fleet FLT-401 (Pick Line)
- Software: v5.4.0 (SWREV-502)
- Previous: v5.3.2 (SWREV-501)
- Started: rolling update at 07:00 UTC
- Phase 1: DEV-801, DEV-802 updated at 08:05 UTC
- Phase 2: DEV-803 updated at 08:09 UTC
- Phase 3: DEV-804, DEV-805 (pending, halted due to misreads)
- Status: HALTED — scanner misreads detected on updated devices
Changes in v5.4.0: New scanner pipeline, updated exposure parameters, revised decode algorithm.

customer_response_draft:
Dear Atlas Retail Robotics Team,

We are aware of the issue affecting your devices at Atlas Fulfillment Hub. This message is to acknowledge the impact and let you know where our investigation stands.

What we know so far: our investigation has converged on a likely cause — software version 5. We are treating this as the leading explanation and will confirm as we proceed.

Current status: 3 device(s) impacted. Your other devices continue to operate normally.

Next steps: our operations team is continuing the investigation and will provide the next update as soon as there is confirmed information to share. We are not stating a resolution time until we have evidence to support one.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Operations Team
